By registering, you agree to our[Privacy Statement](/privacy-policy) and [Terms and Conditions](/terms-of-use). ## Program Details Degree : Masters Major : Artificial Intelligence | Computer Science | Software Engineering Area of study : Information and Communication Technologies Timing : Full time Course Language : English ## Program Overview ## Master Mention Informatique The Master Mention Informatique program offers high-level scientific and technical education. The program focuses on discerning the most promising technological innovations to prepare students for the rapid evolution of information and communication technologies. ### Presentation of the Formation The Master Mention Informatique proposes an education that attaches importance to identifying, among technological innovations, those that are most promising. This allows students to adapt to the rapid evolution of technologies and prepares them for careers in various fields. ### Composante The program is offered by the Facultť Sciences et Ingťnierie. ### Parcours The Master Mention Informatique offers 8 different parcours: * Intelligence Artificielle: Fondements et Applications (IAFA) * Interaction Homme Machine (IHM) * Sciences du Logiciel (SDL) * SystŤmes Embarquťs et Connectťs: Infrastructures et Logiciels (SECIL) * Interactions de l'Informatique et des Mathťmatiques pour l'Intelligence Artificielle (IMA) * Recherche Opťrationnelle et Optimisation (RO) * Sciences et Ingťnierie des Donnťes (SID) * Computer Science for Aerospace (CSA) ### Details of Each Parcours #### Master Parcours Computer Science for Aerospace (CSA) * Duration: 2 years * Level of Exit: Bac + 5 (Niveau 7) * This parcours will not be open for enrollment in the 2026/2027 academic year. #### Master Parcours Intelligence Artificielle: Fondements et Applications (IAFA) * Duration: 2 years * Level of Exit: Bac + 5 (Niveau 7) * The IAFA parcours aims for a high level of mastery of AI foundations and develops expertise in students based on application domain problems and their societal and industrial impacts. #### Master Parcours Interaction Homme Machine (IHM) * Duration: 2 years * Level of Exit: Bac + 5 (Niveau 7) * The IHM Master forms professionals specializing in the design and development of interactive applications, mastering techniques specific to computer science, design, and human factors. #### Master Parcours Interactions de l'Informatique et des Mathťmatiques pour l'Intelligence Artificielle (IMA) * Duration: 2 years * Level of Exit: Bac + 5 (Niveau 7) * The IMA parcours aims to form experts in the field of AI by combining fundamental scientific skills in both mathematics and computer science. This parcours will not be open for enrollment in the 2026/2027 academic year. #### Master Parcours Recherche Opťrationnelle Optimisation (RO) * Duration: 2 years * Level of Exit: Bac + 5 (Niveau 7) * At the interface of Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, and Engineering, RO models complex systems of industry and large organizations to design decision-making tools. This parcours will not be open for enrollment in the 2026/2027 academic year. #### Master Parcours Sciences et Ingťnierie des Donnťes (SID) * Duration: 2 years * Level of Exit: Bac + 5 (Niveau 7) * The SID Master forms data science experts, mastering all aspects related to data collection, storage, processing, and valorization. #### Master Parcours Sciences du Logiciel (SDL) * Duration: 2 years * Level of Exit: Bac + 5 (Niveau 7) * The SDL Master forms software engineering experts, relying on methods, models, formalisms, and languages to ensure product quality. #### Master Parcours SystŤmes Embarquťs et Connectťs: Infrastructures et Logiciels (SECIL) * Duration: 2 years * Level of Exit: Bac + 5 (Niveau 7) * The SECIL parcours aims to form computer scientists specializing in the design, development, evaluation of embedded and connected computer systems, and the underlying hardware and software infrastructures. ### Capacitť d'Accueil Globale The global capacity for access to the Master Mention Informatique for the 2026 academic year is 184 students. ### Partenariats The program has partnerships with several institutions, including: * Institut National Polytechnique de Toulouse (INPT) * Ecole Nationale de l'Aviation Civile (ENAC) * Institut National des Sciences Appliquťes (INSA) ### Et AprŤs? #### Compťtences Graduates of the Master Mention Informatique will acquire a range of skills, including: * Identifying and implementing a machine learning approach for data analysis * Relating problem categories to appropriate resolution algorithms and evaluating their relevance * Mastering compilation and optimization principles to design and develop a translator/compiler integrating constraints to optimize generated code * Identifying problems that can be parallelized, choosing the appropriate calculation model, and implementing it to solve the problem * Evaluating and mastering the complexity of software development in relation to a scientific and technical application domain * Analyzing a scientific research document and extracting relevant information regarding a problem to be solved * Understanding at least one foreign language and expressing oneself easily orally and in writing in that language, particularly in a professional context * Managing a small team, understanding a financial balance sheet, and carrying out an enterprise creation approach * Taking into account societal values in one's work: knowledge of social relations, environment, and sustainable development, ethics #### Fiche RNCP The program is listed in the Rťpertoire National des Certifications Professionnelles (RNCP). #### Dťbouchťs Professionnels Graduates can pursue careers in various sectors, including: * R&D: management and engineering studies, industrial research and development * Production, operation, and maintenance: computer studies and development, team development management, operation engineer, methods service manager, software architect, etc. * Information systems: consulting and project management, administration, expertise, and support, direction Further study is possible in a doctoral program. ## About University --- ### Overview: Universite Toulouse III - Paul Sabatier is a public research university located in Toulouse, France. It is known for its strong focus on science, technology, engineering, and mathematics (STEM) fields. --- ### Services Offered: --- ### Student Life and Campus Experience: The university offers a vibrant campus life with various resources and activities for students. These include: ### Health and Social Services: The university provides access to health services, social support, and student assistance programs. ### Housing and Dining: Students can find accommodation options and dining facilities on campus. ### Student Employment: The university offers opportunities for students to find part-time jobs. ### Childcare: A crèche is available for students with young children. ### Accessibility and Inclusion: The university is committed to providing accessible facilities and services for students with disabilities. ### Cultural Activities: The university hosts a variety of cultural events, including concerts, exhibitions, and theater performances. ### Sports: Students can participate in various sports activities and access sports facilities. ### Student Clubs and Organizations: The university has a thriving student association scene, offering opportunities for students to engage in extracurricular activities and social events. --- ### Key Reasons to Study There: ### Strong Research Reputation: The university is renowned for its research excellence, particularly in STEM fields. ### International Focus: The university has strong international partnerships and encourages student mobility. ### Vibrant Campus Life: The university offers a diverse and engaging campus experience with a wide range of resources and activities. ### Access to Resources: Students have access to excellent libraries, research facilities, and other resources. --- ### Academic Programs: Universite Toulouse III - Paul Sabatier offers a wide range of academic programs, including: ### Science: Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Earth Sciences, Mathematics, Computer Science ### Technology and Engineering: Aerospace Engineering, Civil Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering ### Health Sciences: Medicine, Pharmacy, Dentistry, Nursing ### Social Sciences: Economics, Sociology, Psychology, Political Science ### Humanities: Literature, History, Philosophy, Languages --- ### Other: **Top 570**Average ranking globally [View university profile](/university/54638/universite-toulouse-iii-paul-sabatier) ## Gallery ## Location Earn as you learn Join our Ambassador program and help other students study abroad, as you make money. Centred on Toulouse, European space and aeronautics capital, UPS is a renowned European university with a global outlook. ## University Toulouse III - Paul Sabatier Master's Programmes * [### Biomolecular sciences (Mechanisms and therapeutic targets) M.Sc. / Full-time / On campus Tuition unknown 2 years University Toulouse III - Paul Sabatier Toulouse, France Tuition unknown 2 years](https://www.mastersportal.com/studies/458861/biomolecular-sciences.html) [View more programmes](https://www.mastersportal.com/search/master?oi=1394) ## University Toulouse III - Paul Sabatier Overview ### Education The university offers courses in Science and Technology, Health, Sports Science, Eco-Management, and Information and Communication. ### Research The challenges of understanding matter and life: mathematics, the science of infinite scale and infinite speed, neuroscience, complex systems.Society's major problems: state and future of the environment, natural and industrial risk, biodiversity, genetics, medical research and health.Technological and industrial needs: embedded systems, space technology, IT and automation, chemical engineering, new materials, aeronautics, biotechnologies, pharmacology, nanotechnologies. Université Paul Sabatier research policy is supported by the following structures: * Research Strategy Department (DSR) * Scientific Council (CS) * Laboratory Support Department (DSL) : DSL's Interactive Schematic ### Career A students' preparation to becoming a professional is part of a journey that begins for a sixth-form pupil and continues on into his or her first steps at the University. The goal of this journey is a graduate's first job within a company. Naturally, the different procedures applied in this approach are transferable throughout a graduate's life. ## University Toulouse III - Paul Sabatier Key Statistics & Highlights * #331 Ranking * 1 Masters * 62 Scholarships * 2,609 Academic Staff * 35,017 Students * Public Institution Type ### Student clubs More than 50 associations are active at UPS in all fields, providing opportunities for you to get involved and express yourself. Don't hesitate to make contact and contribute your ideas or start your own association. ### Housing services Accommodation offers from private landlords (rooms, studios, and apartments that are well located for UPS students). ### Library services The UPS Joint Document Service (Service commun de la documentation - SCD) consists of: * two university libraries: Medicine and Sciences, located on three sites, * and all the university's associated libraries (UFR and laboratory libraries). ### Medical services Inter-university Service for Preventive Medicine and Promoting Health: The Inter-university Service for Preventive Medicine and Promoting Health sees students at its three Toulouse Centres and at centres at satellite sites. ## University Toulouse III - Paul Sabatier Scholarships Master [Bachelor](https://www.bachelorsportal.com/universities/1394/university-toulouse-iii-paul-sabatier.html#Scholarships "Scholarships provided for Bachelor by University Toulouse III - Paul Sabatier") [PhD](https://www.phdportal.com/universities/1394/university-toulouse-iii-paul-sabatier.html#Scholarships "Scholarships provided for PhD by University Toulouse III - Paul Sabatier") ### University Toulouse III - Paul Sabatier Scholarships Below you will find scholarships related to University Toulouse III - Paul Sabatier.
